newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Astra '96 profit up 9 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Astra '96 profit up 9 pct.

text.p: Swedish drugs company Astra was expected to post a pre-tax profit of 13.17 billion crowns for 1996 compared to 12.06 billion crowns in 1995, a Reuters poll of 17 analysts showed on Friday.
Forecasts varied between 12.96 billion and 13.35 billion crowns with the average largely unchanged from a previous Reuters poll at the end of Octohber.
Analysts expected Astra to report earnings per share (EPS) of 15.26 crowns compared to 14.22 crowns in 1995.
They forecast Astra would propose a dividend of 3.50 crowns compared to 3.00 crowns in 1995.

Analysts interviewed from the poll were from Aros, Carnegie, Danske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Enskilda, Fiba, Fischer, Handelsbanken, James Capel, Kleinwort Benson, Matteus, Morgan Stanley, Paribas, SBC Warburg, Swedbank, UBS and Ohman.
Astra is due to release its 1996 report on February 19.
